name: The Ren'ai Simulation 2 ~Fureai~
original_name: THE恋愛シミュレーション2〜ふれあい〜
source: You're a 19-year-old student, that fails to pass the exams to university and starts working as an assistant teacher in a private school. You'll be assigned with the task of helping 5 girls with their exams, who will get closer to you as the game passes.
